- Website: https://www.lolscript.store/

- Payment: card, crypto, Binance Gift Card. Keys are delivered instantly on-screen and by email.

## Products

- [LoL Script](https://www.lolscript.store/lol-script): League of Legends script with evade, skillshot prediction, orbwalker, target selector, champion combos, and item/summoner activator for 150+ champions. Runs on your own PC from a USB loader, no second PC needed. From $3.99 (1-day key).
- [LoL Vanguard Emulator](https://www.lolscript.store/lol-vanguard-emulator): removes Riot Vanguard from your PC so League of Legends runs without the anti-cheat. From $79.99.
